title: Protection from fleas & beasts
data:
Fourth: The companions of the Holy Prophet (s) are reported, in one of the military expeditions, to have complained to him about fleas that annoyed them. Instructing them, the Holy Prophet (s) said: When you go to sleep, you may say this supplicatory prayer:
اَيُّهَا الْاَسْوَدُ الْوَثَّابُ اَلَّذِىْ لَايُبَالِىْ غَلَقًا وَلَابَابًا عَزَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ بِاُمِّ الْكِتَابِ اَنْ لَاتُؤْذِيَنِىْ وَ اَصْحَابِىْ اِلٰى اَنْ يَذْهَبَ اللَّيْلُ وَ يَجْيِئَ الصُّبْحُ بِمَا جَاۤءَ
AAYUHAA ALAASWADU ALWATHAABU AALADHIAA LAAYUBAALIAA GHALAQANA WALAABAABANA A'AZAMTU A'ALAYKA BIAUMI ALKITAABI AAN LAATU'DHIYANIAA WA AASHAABIAA AILAAAA AAN YADHHABA ALLAYLU WA YAJYI'A ALSUBHU BIMAA JAA'A
May Allah accept this supplication.
اَعُوْذُ بِرَبِّ دَانِيَالَ وَ الْجُبِّ،مِنْ كُلِّ اَسَدٍ مُسْتَاْصِدٍ
AAA'UWDHU BIRABI DAANIYAALA WA ALJUBI،MIN KULI AASADIN MUSTAASIDIN
May Allah accept this supplication.
عَزَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ بِعَزِيْمَةِ اللّٰهِ وَعَزِيْمَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ عَزِيْمَةِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ دَاوُدَ وَ عَزِيْمَةِ اَمِيْرِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلِىِّ بْنِ اَبِىْ طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَالْاَئِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
A'AZAMTU A'ALAYKA BIA'AZIYMAHI I WAA'AZIYMAHI MUHAMADIN SALAAA U A'ALAYHI WA AAALIHEE WA A'AZIYMAHI SULAYMAANA BNA DAAWUDA WA A'AZIYMAHI AAMIYRIALMU'MINIYNA A'ALIAAI BNI AABIAA TAALIBIN A'ALAYHI ALSALAAMU WAALAA'IMAHI ALTAAHIRIYNA A'ALAYHIMU ALSALAAMU MIN BAA'DIHI
May Allah accept this supplication.
